shared_prompt: Create one entirely original 16:9 landscape animal card illustration for an original browser zoo strategy game. Show one zoologically recognizable individual with accurate anatomy, markings, and proportions for the exact species or breed named in the card-specific subject. Use contemporary cut-paper collage mixed with matte gouache, bold rounded geometric shapes, subtle handmade paper grain, and a clean thumbnail-readable silhouette. Keep the animal and every essential feature inside the central 80 percent with comfortable crop-safe margins. Use gentle natural light and a cohesive forest-green, coral, ochre, cream, and teal supporting palette adapted to the species and habitat. The composition and visual identity must be entirely original, with no reference to or imitation of Ark Nova or any existing board-game artwork. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, card border, UI, badge, frame, copied pose, humans, cages, extra animals, photorealism, glossy 3D, or visual clutter.

cards.name: GOLDEN LION TAMARIN
cards.subject: Golden lion tamarin (Leontopithecus rosalia), tiny golden-orange monkey with radiant mane, dark face, slender limbs and long tail, gripping a mossy Atlantic-rainforest branch.

cards.name: BOLIVIAN RED HOWLER
cards.subject: Bolivian red howler monkey (Alouatta sara), robust rust-red body, dark bare face, heavy throat and long prehensile tail curled around a Bolivian Amazon canopy branch.

cards.name: ECUADORIAN SQUIRELL MONKEY
cards.subject: Ecuadorian squirrel monkey (Saimiri cassiquiarensis macrodon), small olive-gold monkey with yellow limbs, white facial mask, black muzzle and very long slender tail in humid lowland rainforest.

cards.name: COTTON-TOP TAMARIN
cards.subject: Cotton-top tamarin (Saguinus oedipus), tiny monkey with dramatic flowing white crest, dark bare face, white chest and mottled brown-black body in Colombian forest canopy.

cards.name: NILE CROCODILE
cards.subject: Nile crocodile (Crocodylus niloticus), powerful olive-brown crocodile with broad V-shaped snout, raised eyes and nostrils, armored scutes and heavy tail on an African riverbank.

cards.name: WESTERN GREEN MAMBA
cards.subject: Western green mamba (Dendroaspis viridis), slender vivid leaf-green arboreal snake with narrow elongated head and dark-edged scales curving around a West African rainforest branch.

cards.name: AFRICAN SPURRED TORTOISE
cards.subject: African spurred tortoise or sulcata (Centrochelys sulcata), large sandy-tan tortoise with high grooved shell, elephantine forelegs and conspicuous hind-leg spurs in Sahel scrub.

cards.name: ROCK MONITOR
cards.subject: Rock monitor (Varanus albigularis), heavy muscular gray-brown lizard with pale speckles and bands, broad head, powerful claws and forked tongue on an African rocky outcrop.

cards.name: COMMON AGAMA
cards.subject: Breeding male common agama (Agama agama), fiery orange-red head and shoulders with vivid cobalt-blue body and tail, basking on sun-warmed African granite.

cards.name: INDIAN ROCK PYTHON
cards.subject: Indian rock python (Python molurus), thick tan snake with irregular dark-brown saddle blotches and broad wedge-shaped head, coiled beside a shaded Indian woodland river.

cards.name: KING COBRA
cards.subject: King cobra (Ophiophagus hannah), very large olive-brown cobra raised upright with long narrow hood spread and dark chevron bands on a South Asian forest floor.

cards.name: KOMODO DRAGON
cards.subject: Komodo dragon (Varanus komodoensis), enormous heavy gray-brown monitor with massive torso, muscular bowed limbs, long tail and yellow forked tongue on a dry Indonesian volcanic island.

cards.name: VEILED CHAMELEON
cards.subject: Veiled chameleon (Chamaeleo calyptratus), green lizard with extremely tall casque, turquoise-yellow side bands, independently focused eyes, grasping feet and curled tail on a Yemeni shrub.

cards.name: CHINESE WATER DRAGON
cards.subject: Chinese water dragon (Physignathus cocincinus), vivid green lizard with long banded tail, pale throat, strong limbs and jagged back crest perched above a humid East Asian river.

cards.name: AMERICAN ALLIGATOR
cards.subject: American alligator (Alligator mississippiensis), dark charcoal alligator with exceptionally broad rounded U-shaped snout, armored back and heavy tail in a cypress swamp.

cards.name: BROAD-SNOUTED CAIMAN
cards.subject: Broad-snouted caiman (Caiman latirostris), olive-gray caiman with distinctly short, very broad rounded snout, raised eyes and compact armored body at a South American marsh edge.

cards.name: GALAPAGOS GIANT TORTOISE
cards.subject: Galápagos giant tortoise (Chelonoidis niger complex), enormous ancient tortoise with high dark domed shell, long wrinkled neck and massive columnar legs among lava and island scrub.

cards.name: ANACONDA
cards.subject: Green anaconda (Eunectes murinus), immense thick olive-green snake with round black spots and ochre side blotches, partially submerged in an Amazon flooded forest.

cards.name: BOA CONSTRICTOR
cards.subject: Boa constrictor (Boa constrictor), muscular tan snake with crisp reddish-brown saddle markings and brick-red patterned tail coiled along a tropical forest branch.

cards.name: EUROPEAN POND TURTLE
cards.subject: European pond turtle (Emys orbicularis), small dark freshwater turtle covered in fine yellow spots across shell, head and legs, resting on a half-submerged woodland-pond log.

cards.name: COMMON EUROPEAN ADDER
cards.subject: Common European adder (Vipera berus), short stout viper with triangular head and bold continuous dark dorsal zigzag among European heath, moss and warm stones.

cards.name: COMMON WALL LIZARD
cards.subject: Common wall lizard (Podarcis muralis), small slender brown-olive lizard with mottled dark reticulation, long tail and delicate toes on an old sun-warmed European stone wall.

cards.name: EUROPEAN GRASS SNAKE
cards.subject: European grass snake (Natrix natrix), slender olive-gray snake with clear yellow-cream collar edged in black, round pupil and fine side bars beside a wet meadow pond.

cards.name: SLOW WORM
cards.subject: Slow worm (Anguis fragilis), glossy bronze legless lizard with blunt head, visible eyelid, small mouth and smooth scales moving through mossy woodland leaf litter.

cards.name: SALTWATER CROCODILE
cards.subject: Saltwater crocodile (Crocodylus porosus), enormous gray-olive crocodile with massive broad snout, rough armored scutes and heavy tail surfacing in an Australian mangrove estuary.

cards.name: GOULD'S MONITOR
cards.subject: Gould's monitor or sand goanna (Varanus gouldii), long athletic sandy-brown lizard with cream-yellow speckles, dark eye stripe, banded tail and forked tongue on Australian red sand.

cards.name: FRILLED LIZARD
cards.subject: Frilled lizard (Chlamydosaurus kingii), mottled brown lizard with enormous circular orange-red neck frill fully spread, long legs and tail in northern Australian eucalyptus woodland.

cards.name: INLAND TAIPAN
cards.subject: Inland taipan (Oxyuranus microlepidotus), slender smooth tan-olive snake with subtly darker rounded head and fine scale edging in an alert coil on cracked Australian floodplain clay.

cards.name: THORNY DEVIL
cards.subject: Thorny devil (Moloch horridus), small stocky desert lizard covered in conical spines, ochre-red-cream camouflage and distinctive false-head knob on Australian red sand.

cards.name: AFRICAN OSTRICH
cards.subject: Adult male African ostrich (Struthio camelus), towering black-bodied bird with broad white wing and tail feathers, long bare pinkish neck and powerful two-toed legs on open savanna.

cards.name: SECRETARY BIRD
cards.subject: Secretary bird (Sagittarius serpentarius), tall terrestrial raptor with crane-like legs, gray body, black flight feathers and crest quills, orange bare face, stepping through African grassland.

cards.name: MARABOU
cards.subject: Marabou stork (Leptoptilos crumenifer), huge stork with bald pink head and neck, dangling throat pouch, massive pale bill, hunched black back and white underparts at a wetland.

cards.name: LESSER FLAMINGO
cards.subject: Lesser flamingo (Phoeniconaias minor), slender vivid rose-pink bird with red legs, crimson wing coverts and compact strongly downcurved mostly-black bill in an East African alkaline lake.

cards.name: SHOEBILL
cards.subject: Shoebill (Balaeniceps rex), towering slate-gray wetland bird with shaggy crest, extremely broad shoe-shaped pale hooked bill and intense pale eyes in papyrus swamp.

cards.name: CINEREOUS VULTURE
cards.subject: Cinereous vulture (Aegypius monachus), massive dark-brown vulture with heavy hooked bill, bluish bare head and thick paler neck ruff on an Asian mountain ledge.

cards.name: LONG-BILLED VULTURE
cards.subject: Long-billed vulture (Gyps indicus), large brown vulture with bare dark head and neck, pale ruff, distinctly long narrow ivory bill and streaked wing coverts on an Indian cliff.

cards.name: INDIAN PEAFOWL
cards.subject: Adult male Indian peafowl (Pavo cristatus), iridescent royal-blue neck and crest, metallic green back and long train fanned into a semicircle of vivid eyespots.

cards.name: GREAT HORNBILL
cards.subject: Great hornbill (Buceros bicornis), huge black-and-white bird with massive yellow downcurved bill, high yellow-black casque, white neck and broad white tail band in rainforest canopy.

cards.name: SNOWY OWL
cards.subject: Snowy owl (Bubo scandiacus), large mostly-white owl with sparse charcoal bars, round head without ear tufts, bright yellow eyes and feathered feet on Arctic tundra snow.

cards.name: ANDEAN CONDOR
cards.subject: Andean condor (Vultur gryphus), immense black condor gliding on broad wings with clear white wing panels, white neck ruff and reddish bald male head above Andean peaks.

cards.name: BALD EAGLE
cards.subject: Adult bald eagle (Haliaeetus leucocephalus), crisp white head and tail, dark chocolate body, massive yellow hooked bill and yellow talons above North American coastal forest.

cards.name: KING VULTURE
cards.subject: King vulture (Sarcoramphus papa), white tropical vulture with black flight-feather borders, multicolored bald head and distinctive orange caruncle in Central American rainforest.

cards.name: GREATER RHEA
cards.subject: Greater rhea (Rhea americana), tall flightless bird with shaggy gray-brown plumage, long feathered neck, small head and sturdy three-toed legs walking across pampas.

cards.name: SCARLET MACAW
cards.subject: Scarlet macaw (Ara macao), large parrot with scarlet body, yellow middle wing band, cobalt flight feathers, long tail, pale curved upper bill and white facial patch on an Amazon branch.

cards.name: GOLDEN EAGLE
cards.subject: Golden eagle (Aquila chrysaetos), powerful dark-brown eagle with luminous golden nape, broad partly raised wings and strong yellow talons gripping a European alpine ridge.

cards.name: WHITE STORK
cards.subject: White stork (Ciconia ciconia), tall white bird with glossy black flight feathers, very long straight red bill and long red legs standing in a European wet meadow.

cards.name: GREATER FLAMINGO
cards.subject: Greater flamingo (Phoenicopterus roseus), very tall pale blush-pink bird with long pink legs, elegant curved neck and large pale bill with sharply black tip in a Mediterranean lagoon.

cards.name: EURASIAN EAGLE-OWL
cards.subject: Eurasian eagle-owl (Bubo bubo), enormous mottled tawny-brown owl with prominent long ear tufts, blazing orange eyes and powerful feathered feet in a rocky European forest.

cards.name: BARN OWL
cards.subject: Barn owl (Tyto alba), graceful owl with white heart-shaped facial disc, dark eyes, golden-tawny speckled wings and white underparts gliding over a European meadow at dusk.

cards.name: EMU
cards.subject: Emu (Dromaius novaehollandiae), very tall flightless bird with shaggy double-shafted brown-gray plumage, long blue-gray neck, small head and powerful legs in Australian scrub.

cards.name: AUSTRALIAN PELICAN
cards.subject: Australian pelican (Pelecanus conspicillatus), huge white waterbird with broad black wing panels and extraordinarily long pale-pink bill and pouch at a freshwater wetland.

cards.name: NORTHERN CASSOWARY
cards.subject: Northern or single-wattled cassowary (Casuarius unappendiculatus), massive black bird with tall brown casque, cobalt-blue face and neck, orange-red lower neck and exactly one central red throat wattle in New Guinea rainforest.

cards.name: LAUGHING KOOKABURRA
cards.subject: Laughing kookaburra (Dacelo novaeguineae), stocky kingfisher with cream head and chest, broad dark eye stripe, mottled brown wings with turquoise patches and heavy straight bill on eucalyptus.

cards.name: LESSER BIRD-OF-PARADISE
cards.subject: Adult male lesser bird-of-paradise (Paradisaea minor) displaying with maroon body, emerald throat shield, yellow crown and long flowing golden flank plumes in New Guinea canopy.

cards.name: (DOMESTIC) GOAT
cards.subject: Domestic goat (Capra hircus), friendly cream-and-caramel goat with short backward-curving horns, horizontal pupils, neat beard and cloven hooves in a sunny petting meadow.

cards.name: SHEEP
cards.subject: Domestic sheep (Ovis aries), gentle adult ewe with dense curly ivory fleece, natural pale face, horizontal pupils, slim lower legs and cloven hooves in a flowering meadow.

cards.name: HORSE
cards.subject: Domestic horse (Equus caballus), healthy chestnut horse with flowing dark mane and tail, white blaze and balanced long legs in a calm paddock stance.

cards.name: DONKEY
cards.subject: Domestic donkey (Equus asinus), compact gray donkey with exceptionally long upright ears, pale muzzle and eye rings, dark dorsal stripe and short upright mane in an orchard meadow.

cards.name: DOMESTIC RABBIT
cards.subject: Domestic rabbit (Oryctolagus cuniculus domesticus), plump upright-eared white-and-tan rabbit with rounded haunches, bright dark eye and compact front paws among meadow clover.

cards.name: MANGALICA
cards.subject: Mangalica pig (Sus scrofa domesticus), distinctive woolly pig with dense long curly blond fleece, dark snout, small forward ears and sturdy short legs in a rustic pasture.

cards.name: GUINEA PIG
cards.subject: Domestic guinea pig (Cavia porcellus), small round-bodied tricolor animal with smooth caramel, white and dark-brown patches, tiny rounded ears and no visible tail among clover.

cards.name: ALPACA
cards.subject: Domestic alpaca (Vicugna pacos), gentle cream animal with dense fleece, fluffy topknot, long slender neck, compact body, straight spear-shaped ears and split upper lip in pasture.

cards.name: COCONUT LORIKEET
cards.subject: Coconut lorikeet (Trichoglossus haematodus), small nectar parrot with cobalt head, red-orange breast, narrow yellow collar, green wings, blue-green tail and orange bill feeding from coconut blossom.

cards.name: BENNETT'S WALLABY
cards.subject: Bennett's or Tasmanian red-necked wallaby (Notamacropus rufogriseus rufogriseus), compact gray-brown wallaby with rusty-red nape, pale cheek stripe, powerful hind legs and thick tail at an Australian woodland edge.
